meta.note: Vanilla v1.0+ at level 300: 4 starting skill points + 1 per level (299) = 303 total. All five attributes start at level 1. Perk magazines grant levels without spending points. Synced with official perk tree (wiki.gg + 7d2d.net builds guide).
